mapper.select: select id, user_name, password, role, email, status, avatar, created_at, updated_at from user where user_name = #{userName}
select id, user_name, password, role, email, status, avatar, created_at, updated_at from user where email = #{email}
mapper.insert: insert into user (user_name, password, role, email, status, avatar, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userName}, #{password}, #{role}, #{email}, #{status}, #{avatar}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
